Running command: cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_18455",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config",
    "line":317,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '\\'' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, \"''\", 2)) return lex_multiline_string;",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input data contains a triple-quote sequence that triggers entry into multiline string lexing"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
    "line":270,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"advance_n(lexer, strlen(\"'''\") - 1);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Advances pos past the opening triple-quote without bounds checking"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
    "line":273,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3))",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"strncmp reads 3 bytes from lexer->pos without checking if pos is within 3 bytes of lexer->end boundary"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
    "line":273,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3) reads 1 byte past the global static_data buffer",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"When pos is at end-2 (2 bytes before buffer boundary) and the bytes match the first 2 chars of the closing delimiter, strncmp reads a third byte past the global buffer causing global-buffer-overflow"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config",
     "line":317,"operands":["chr","lexer->pos"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
     "line":273,"operands":["lexer->pos","lexer->end"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"lexer->pos + 3","right":"lexer->end"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
     "line":273,"operands":["lexer->pos","lexer->end"],
     "relation":{"op":"ge","left":"lexer->pos + 2","right":"lexer->end"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config",
       "line":317,"operands":["lexer->pos"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string",
       "line":273,"operands":["lexer->pos"]},
      "type":"data","via":["lexer->pos"],
      "relation":{"op":"ge","left":"lexer->pos + 2","right":"lexer->end"}}
   ]
 }}
JSON
